Overview

Beni Mellal is a city in Béni Mellal-Khénifra with a population of 192,000. A city at the foot of the Atlas Mountains, known for its olive groves, waterfalls, and agricultural production. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 295 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
